long_biography.plain_text:
Douglas Rastello led the outright winning crew at the J/70 European regatta in Weymouth in 2023. He had brought together friends who had never raced as a team, agreeing beforehand that each would respect the others' responsibilities. Rastello steered and followed Steve Hunt's tactical directions. Consistent placings in light winds secured the overall victory without a single race win.

Rastello and his wife Debbie are members of the Tahoe Fund's Stewardship Circle. Their three-year giving commitment supports the organisation's continuing work to restore and enhance the Lake Tahoe environment.
